description: Evaluation test cases for mcp-debugger. Each case is a real-world MCP configuration failure pattern, with the user message that triggers it, the config context that reproduces it, and the expected diagnostic findings + fixes the skill should produce.

scoring.phase_coverage: Did the skill hit all expected phases (scan / diagnose / fix / verify)?
scoring.finding_detection: Did the skill identify every expected finding (by id)?
scoring.fix_correctness: Did the prescribed fix match the expected fix?

cases.name: Legacy ~/.claude/mcp.json servers silently ignored in 2.x
cases.user_input: I just upgraded to Claude Code 2.x and now my global MCP servers don't show up. The project-level ones in .mcp.json still work fine.
expected_fixes: Migrate all servers from ~/.claude/mcp.json into ~/.claude.json → top-level mcpServers
Remind user to restart Claude Code

cases.name: Server silently dropped because 'type' field is missing
cases.user_input: I added a new MCP server to my config but it doesn't show up. The other 4 servers I have still work fine.

cases.name: npx server fails on Windows without cmd /c wrapper
cases.user_input: My MCP servers work perfectly on macOS but fail the moment I clone the project onto Windows. npx throws weird 'cannot find module' errors.
expected_fixes: Change command to "cmd" and args to ["/c", "npx", "-y", "@playwright/mcp"]

cases.name: Trailing comma breaks ALL servers in that file
cases.user_input: Suddenly none of my MCP servers work. They all worked yesterday. I didn't change anything except add a comma somewhere.

cases.name: Package named xxx-mcp isn't actually an MCP server
cases.user_input: Server starts and shows in the list, but exposes zero tools. What gives?

context.verification: npm view foo-mcp-cli dependencies — does NOT include @modelcontextprotocol/sdk

expected_fixes: Verify the package actually implements MCP
Replace with the correct MCP server package

cases.name: Project servers in .mcp.json not loading
cases.user_input: I defined MCP servers in my project's .mcp.json but they don't show up. ~/.claude.json has nothing in it.

cases.name: Chinese Windows GBK encoding corrupts ~/.claude.json Unicode
cases.user_input: On my Windows 11 Chinese-locale machine, every time Claude Code saves ~/.claude.json, all my MCP servers break and I see garbled characters.

configs.~/.claude.json: Has non-ASCII user-prompts or comments; was edited by a tool that doesn't force UTF-8

expected_fixes: Always read/write ~/.claude.json with encoding='utf-8' on Windows
Restore from a clean backup if corruption has already happened

cases.name: Stale mcpServers in settings.json shadows everything
cases.user_input: After upgrading Claude Code 2.x, ALL my MCP servers disappeared — even the ones I had for months.

cases.name: SSE server missing url field — won't connect
cases.user_input: I configured a remote SSE MCP server but Claude can't connect to it. The MCP server status stays 'failed'.
expected_fixes: Add '"url": "http://..."' to the SSE server entry
Verify the URL is reachable with curl

cases.name: Server starts then exits immediately (missing env / package not installed)
cases.user_input: My MCP server appears in the list but its tools never load. After a few seconds it's gone.

context.smoke_test: timeout 3 npx -y api-mcp — exits within 3 seconds instead of hanging on stdin

expected_fixes: Run the command directly in a terminal to see the error message
Verify the package is installed and node version is >= 18
